name: Storzen – Store Growth Toolkit for WooCommerce
author: WebTend

sections.description:
Storzen is a performance-first WooCommerce growth toolkit that gives Elementor store builders everything they need in a single, lightweight plugin.

Replace multiple WooCommerce plugins with Storzen—an all-in-one conversion toolkit featuring variation swatches, wishlist, sticky add-to-cart, quick view, product comparison, free shipping bar, flash countdown, stock scarcity, sale notifications, sale badges, and 30+ Elementor widgets for every WooCommerce page.

Every feature is individually toggleable. Disabled features load zero CSS, JS, or PHP — no dead weight on your store.

Documentation | Storzen Pro | Live Demo

⚡ Why Store Owners Choose Storzen

One plugin. Everything you need.
Install Storzen and remove the fragmented plugin stack you’ve been maintaining. Swatches, wishlist, sticky cart, quick view, social proof popups — all built in, all free.

Zero overhead for what you don’t use.
Toggle a module off and it vanishes completely — no enqueued styles, no registered hooks, no database reads. Most WooCommerce plugin bundles can’t say that.

Built for conversions, not just features.
Every module and widget is designed around a proven UX pattern that reduces friction, builds urgency, or lifts average order value.

Elementor-native from the ground up.
Six dedicated Elementor categories. Full control over layout, typography, colors, and spacing from the live editor — no shortcodes, no custom CSS required.

🧩 30+ Elementor Widgets for Every WooCommerce Page

Storzen registers six dedicated Elementor widget categories so you can build any WooCommerce page visually with full design freedom.

Shop Widgets
* Product Card — 3 selectable card styles (Standard, Minimal, Bold)
* Archive Products Grid — auto-detects shop, category, and tag archives
* Product Grid — manual grid with category, tag, and ordering filters
* Product Carousel — touch-friendly Swiper slider
* Tab Products — category-tabbed product showcase
* List Products — compact comparison-style layout
* Shop with Sidebar — grid plus live-filter sidebar in one widget

Single Product Widgets
* Product Title, Price, Rating, Meta, Description, Gallery
* Add to Cart button with AJAX support
* Sticky Add to Cart Bar (inline Elementor control)
* Buy Now button
* Related Products slider
* Realtime Visitor Counter
* Product Service Info & Utility Links block

Cart Widgets
* Cart Table
* Cart Totals
* Cart Coupon
* Mini Cart

Checkout Widgets
* Full Checkout Form widget
* Checkout layout customization controls

Thank You Page Widgets
* Order summary, customer details, and upsell placements

My Account Widgets
* Account Login form
* Dashboard navigation & content areas

🚀 10 Free Conversion Modules

Each module is independent, individually toggleable, and ships with its own settings panel (General, Display, and Behavior tabs). Enable only what your store needs.

Variation Swatches
Replace WooCommerce’s plain dropdowns with color swatches, image swatches, or button swatches on variable products. Supports tooltip preview, out-of-stock cross-out, and custom swatch sizes.

Sale Notification (Social Proof Popups)
Display real recent-purchase popups to build buyer confidence. Configurable with real WooCommerce order data or virtual demo data. Control position, timing, delay, and animation.

Quick View
Let shoppers preview products — gallery, variations, add-to-cart — in a lightbox modal without leaving the shop page. Reduces the back-button friction that kills conversions.

Sale Badge
Automatically display Hot, New, and Sale percentage badges on product cards. Configure label text, colors, and badge shape from the settings panel.

Wishlist
Let customers save products to a wishlist without creating an account. Supports both guests (cookie-based) and logged-in members. Shareable wishlist URL included.

Compare Products
Add a side-by-side product comparison table. Customers pick products to compare; the table shows price, rating, attributes, and add-to-cart — all AJAX-powered.

Sticky Add to Cart
A floating product bar (image, title, price, variations, ATC + Buy Now) that appears when the native add-to-cart button scrolls out of view. Proven to recover scroll-away customers.

Flash Sale Countdown
Show a live countdown timer on product pages and shop cards, powered by WooCommerce’s built-in sale end date field. No extra meta setup required.

Free Shipping Progress Bar
Show customers exactly how much more they need to spend to unlock free shipping. Proven to increase average order value. Updates live as customers add items to cart.

Stock Scarcity Messages
Automatically show “Only X left in stock!” urgency messages based on real WooCommerce stock data. Configure thresholds, message wording, and styling.

📄 Ready-to-Import Elementor Templates

Storzen ships with professionally designed Elementor page templates for every WooCommerce page — import with one click from the admin panel:

  • Shop Page (standard layout)
  • Shop Page with Search (search-first layout)
  • Single Product — 3 distinct layout styles
  • Cart Page
  • Checkout Page
  • Thank You Page
  • My Account Page

🔒 Performance & Security

Toggle-based loading — OFF means truly OFF.
Disabled widgets are never registered with Elementor. Disabled modules never load their PHP class, never enqueue CSS or JS, and never touch the database. This is enforced at the bootstrap level, not just a conditional check.

Secure AJAX handling.
All AJAX endpoints are protected with WordPress nonces and current_user_can() capability checks. Every database query uses $wpdb->prepare().

No external requests.
The free plugin makes zero outbound network calls — no telemetry, no license pings, no analytics.

HPOS compatible.
Storzen uses WooCommerce CRUD methods throughout and declares High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) compatibility.

🛠 Developer Friendly

  • Translation-ready — all strings use the storzen text domain; .pot file included
  • Template overrides — copy any file from plugins/storzen/templates/ or plugins/storzen/woocommerce/ to your theme for full customization
  • Action & filter hooks — extend widget definitions, module lists, and output without touching plugin files
  • WPCS-compliant codebase — follows WordPress and WooCommerce coding standards throughout
  • PSR-4 autoloader — bundled admin framework uses a clean autoloaded structure

🔓 Storzen Pro

Storzen Pro adds advanced features for stores that need more:

  • AJAX Sidebar Filters — live filter by search, categories, attributes, stock status, and ratings — no page reload
  • Full Single Product Widget Set — rating stars, tabs, share buttons, and more
  • Cart & Checkout Drawer Widgets — slide-in cart drawer and checkout layout widgets
  • Full My Account Widget Set — complete account page visual builder
  • Cart Module — AJAX add-to-cart, mini-cart drawer, cross-sell popup
  • Pre-Order Module — accept orders for out-of-stock products before they arrive
  • Quick Checkout Module — one-click checkout modal to reduce cart abandonment
  • Floating Cart Module — persistent floating cart icon with live item count
  • Currency Switcher Module — multi-currency support for international stores
  • PDF Invoice Module — auto-generate branded invoices attached to order emails
  • Priority support

All free settings carry over to Pro automatically — no re-configuration needed.
sections.faq:
Do I need both WooCommerce and Elementor?

Yes. Storzen requires both WooCommerce (for store data) and Elementor (for widget rendering). If either is missing or outdated, Storzen shows an admin notice and gracefully self-disables widget registration without breaking your site.

Will Storzen slow down my site?

No. Storzen uses a strict toggle-based loading system enforced at the bootstrap level. Every widget and module you leave disabled loads absolutely nothing — no PHP, no CSS, no JS, no database queries. Only enabled features have any runtime cost.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes. All shop and product widgets fully support variable products. The Variation Swatches module specifically enhances variable products by replacing native dropdowns with visual swatches, with full support for out-of-stock states and swatch tooltips.

What is the difference between widgets and modules?

Widgets are visual building blocks you place in Elementor (Product Grid, Product Carousel, Checkout Form, etc.). Modules are sitewide background features (Sale Notification, Sticky ATC, Free Shipping Bar, etc.) that work automatically once enabled — they don’t require an Elementor page at all. Most stores use both: widgets for layout, modules for conversion.

Can I customize templates and styles?

Yes. Copy any file from plugins/storzen/templates/ or plugins/storzen/woocommerce/ into your theme folder ({theme}/storzen/ or {theme}/woocommerce/). Your customizations survive every plugin update. For Elementor widgets, all styling is done from the widget’s Style tab.

Is Storzen compatible with HPOS?

Yes. Storzen uses WooCommerce CRUD methods throughout and explicitly declares HPOS compatibility via the woocommerce_feature_high_performance_order_storage_ready filter. It works with both legacy post-based orders and the new HPOS order tables.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes. All user-facing strings use the storzen text domain. A complete .pot file is included in the /languages/ folder. Compatible with Loco Translate, WPML, and Polylang.

Does Storzen send data externally?

The free plugin makes zero outbound requests — no usage tracking, no analytics, no phone-home of any kind.

What happens to my settings when I upgrade to Storzen Pro?

All settings carry over automatically. Storzen Pro reads the same option keys as the free version, so all widget toggles and module settings work immediately after activation. The free plugin self-disables cleanly when Pro is detected.

Which themes does Storzen work with?

Storzen works with any properly coded WordPress theme — classic themes, FSE/block themes, and Elementor-built themes (Hello Elementor, Astra, GeneratePress, OceanWP, etc.). Template overrides let you match any design system.

Where can I get support?

Free users: WordPress.org support forum. Pro license holders: priority email support via webtend.net. Always include your WordPress, WooCommerce, Elementor, and PHP versions when opening a support request.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New: Shop with Sidebar widget — combined product grid and live-filter sidebar in one Elementor widget.
  • New: 3 selectable product card styles (Style One, Style Two, Style Three).
  • New: Tab Products widget for category-tabbed product showcases.
  • New: List Products widget for compact comparison-style product layouts.
  • Improvement: All widgets fully responsive across mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints.

1.0.3

  • Initial public release.
  • 7 core Elementor widgets — Product Card, Product Grid, Archive Grid, Product Carousel, and more.
  • WooCommerce template override support for cart, checkout, and quantity input.
  • Translation-ready with full .pot file include.
